answer: One walnut nursery bed per applicant runs 120 days on a 150 token deposit and an 80 dollar license. Forty saplings wear numbered steel bands, photographed by a ruler monthly, with a violet dye mark on the tag to prove the photo is fresh. A neighbor signs the log, and an onyx seal pressed at intake marks each page, so a copied page stands out. Forging 10,000 nurseries freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 800,000 dollars in saplings. Like a vineyard row where every vine is numbered, no stranger claims a harvest he never pruned. A forged bed loses its deposit and waits 180 days to reapply.
